SYNTHETIC MODEL ACT
(invented for tests; not a commission text)

Drafted by an invented committee

Copyright 2026 Example Drafting Body

TABLE OF CONTENTS
Section 1. Short Title	1
Section 2. Definitions	1

Prefatory Note
This invented act exists only to exercise the cleaning of model texts.

Section 1. Short Title
This [act] may be cited as the Synthetic Lantern Registry Act.

Section 2. Definitions
In this [act]:
(1) "Lantern" means a portable lamp kept under [cite to this state's lamp code].
(2) "Registry" means the list kept by [the secretary of state][the registrar].
[Drafting Note: a state may rename the registry.]

Comment
The definitions follow an invented convention. This comment runs on
for two lines and is not law.

Section 3. Registration
A keeper shall register each lantern within [60] days, before the [specify the court in the enacting state] or the registrar [ . . . ].
Legislative Note: A state that has no registrar should name another office here.
The note continues for a second paragraph.

[Section 4. Optional Fees
The registrar may charge a fee not less than [[insert a number not less than 5 and not more than 20] dollars.]

Section 5. Effective Date
This [act] takes effect [the effective date of this [act]].
